thread:
Maya (PM): RCA published for last night's serving disruption: https://redwood.internal/rca/2065004321. Short summary: concurrent model hot-swap + aggressive cache eviction led to transient KV cold-starts and ~5x tail latency for ~18 minutes. Action items and owners below — ping if you need reassignment.

hao-bot: Incident doc ready with timeline and attachments. Reference: incident-2065004321.pdf

Jon (Runtime): I'll take the deterministic repro and add CI regression tests that simulate overlapping swaps. Planning a PR with tests + fix for serialized swap path by EOW.

Priya (SRE): Implemented temporary guard: during swap window we now block eviction for affected shards and raise an alert on cache-hit-rate < 90%. Created ticket SRE-7702 for long-term telemetry improvements.

Maya (PM): Also added a short customer note draft for affected customers; sending to comms for review. Expect comms to go out after checkpoint if no new regressions.

Jon (Runtime): For the longer-term fix I'll patch the swap orchestrator to do a warm-write pass before switching traffic. This should remove the cold KV penalty.

Priya (SRE): Scheduling a 20-min checkpoint next Wed 09:30 PT to verify fixes and to approve the customer note. Invite sent to #postmortem-checkpoint.

Maya (PM): Owners recap: Jon -> repro + runtime patch + CI; Priya -> monitoring + alerts + canary gates; Maya -> comms + checkpoint. Please ACK in-thread.

Jon (Runtime): ACK.

Priya (SRE): ACK.

Maya (PM): Thanks everyone  we'll close action items as PRs and tickets land.
